content.label: Does not work as the pictures suggest. All it does is create a launcher list in a widget. Does not switch anything off, does not hide launcher bar at the bottom and the widget is not offer in a size to fill full screen on iPhone max. Don’t waste your £4.99. Totally not as described I would like my money back
Does not work correctly with iOS 26 or Liquid Glass, once it’s updated it might be worth it again
Didn’t work. Emailed customer support. Nothing.

It’s a good app, just needs a bit of an update for liquid.

I saw this app as an opportunity to pay a one-off fee and avoid some other competitors which have subscriptions but honestly I feel as though money was water on this app. The shortcuts don’t work as intended in some cases (i.e. Settings and Phone) which is incredibly annoying. Honestly, just go with the apps that have good reviews to save  yourself time and money.

title.label: don’t have basic apps to add to widget + no communication

content.label: It’s a good app with a nice widget system but unfortunately Discord and Shopify aren’t able to be added to it, unlike other apps i’ve used similair to dumbify. I also reached out to support twice via the app but to no response.

A great app for helping with overstimulation. I just wish a few others popular apps were available from the widget list. I’ve resorted to keeping Firefox and Outlook down at the bottom dock area which kind of spoils the look a bit.
Too much money for less features than all the other minimalist apps give you, don’t be fooled by the nice design (the free ones are better)

I would love to use this but it is refusing to launch the shortcuts app to add fundamental apps to the widgets. Cannot get it to work and I really cannot be bothered trying to debug this any more. Probably Apple’s fault but still annoying. 

This app is basically just using the widgets functionality, with each having a list of apps that can be launched, and a matching wallpaper to mask the fact that it’s a widget once pulled onto your home screen. 

I’m not sure the price of the app is worth it considering it doesn’t really lock your phone down, just creates a list for you. iPhone OS17 has this functionality built in with Assistive Access and it actually is locked down. This, plus the annoyance of things not working as fluid as I’d like makes it a no from me. 

Should be a trial version as I wouldn’t have sunk £5 into something that wasted an hour of my life trying to be functional. 

I really do appreciate devs working on apps like this as smartphones are a curse, but I don’t think we’re their yet. 

Not to say don’t give it a go, lots of people seem to have success with it, mine just will not link to the shortcuts app after reinstalling both in different orders, restarting my device etc. Seen others on Reddit with same issue

I really want to love this app. Sadly most apps require a shortcut so when opening them the screen flicks to the shortcut app briefly before the requested app. This is really off putting and creates too much friction to use this app. Feel like I wasted my money unfortunately.

Brilliant app, only issues are to do with Apple’s side, i.e removing App Library, and shortcut app appearing for some apps (but most of the them are fine!)
The only ‘want’ I would love from this app would be to add a smaller widget so I can have 2 widgets on the same page which would allow me to display multiple app choices down to the bottom of the screen
A minor suggestion but please nonetheless!

title.label: This does not make your phone minimalistic or “dumified”

content.label: It only gives you a widget with apps you put in to make it look like texts…Its just your phone with a widge to open apps…just gives you extra steps!

Dev has done a great job being creative to achieve something that Apple doesn’t otherwise allow.

Takes a little bit of setting up but again the dev have done their best to streamline that as much as possible.
Fiddly waste of time £5 wasted

This app takes a little time to set up and sort. It’s excellent at reducing screen time and reduces temptation to open apps you didn’t intend on using. One issue is the constant running of shortcuts. I’ve not found a way to have them run without the shortcuts app loading. I’ve noticed my battery is taking a hit too and assume it’s the constant shortcuts running. If I’m going something wrong please reach out!
Love the app so far. Is there anyway to automate a shortcut or make the shortcut screen not appear when using one for example on the phone app?

This app is great, thanks for making it! Well worth the £4.99 paid. I had been looking into dumb/minimalist phones for quite some time, but was reluctant to lose all or almost all smartphone functionality like the light phone or punkt phones, as well as not really wanting to buy a new phone. 

So with that in mind, this app really does everything i need it to, and setting up custom apps is very easy. If you follow all the recommended settings as well, it really is a seamless experience

I tried the free trials of the main minimalist phone apps and took a risk buying this one. Very pleased so far. Main things I like:

- instantly opens apps (with right settings) other apps open their app then the app i want. 
- light mode actually works 
- multiple widgets allowing more than one page 
- spacer widget 
- control over fonts and sizes 
- adding unlisted apps is easy and works the same. Strange that Reddit isn’t on the pre-made list though
Really simple to set up, very clean and customisable design. Developer is quick to respond to feedback. Much happier with my phone since using this! Thank you 🌟

Just what I’ve been looking for I am glad I stumbled upon this I will spread the word. Took a little time to set it all up, well worth it - my mind feels much clearer and everything is so much easier to use and less chaotic for my ADHD brain. The tutorials were super helpful and it was quick to understand what I needed to do. Glad I took a chance and bought it, I’ve downloaded soooo many apps that I hoped would be like this but they were all not only majorly confusing but expensive subscriptions. This RULES.

Nice idea, but there are a lot of problems. 

It isn’t a smooth experience at all using apple shortcuts because of the multiple screens it has to jump between.

Can’t believe this is £4.99! I would advise anyone reading this to avoid buying this app.
I would like a refund.
Great app. No nonsense.

One of the best apps I’ve bought in years. Does everything you need to simplify the distraction that pervades our modern lives. 

Instructions are clear, and if you follow them and reduce motions in the accessibility settings, everything, not just app launching becomes less distracting and snappier. 

The wallpapers supplied create a unified space with no visible dock. 

Impressive. Thank you.
Hi I would to request a refund because the app widget is not able to show my app list properly also it’s very slow when opening the camera and phone.

title.label: Minimalist app that turns your phone into something simpler

content.label: Really nice app that helps you turn off your phones constant stimulation by just leaving you with a main list of apps. Everything else you remove from your home screen so you just have the main page which is a list and then your App Library. No glitches so far and much cheaper than the alternative app and gives you almost all the same functionality. You’ll still need to do some other leg work to reduce the stimulation from your phone like turning off certain notifications or even using greyscale but this goes a long way. At the moment the developer is very responsive and open to feedback as well which is a plus
